description: Videos on one YouTube hashtag page: video id, title, channel, view count text (exact for most videos), age text, duration and link, as shown on the first page (about 10-12 videos). No comments and no full history; YouTube's page layout can change. Takes about 11 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_youtube_comments when you need first page of top comments on one YouTube video: author; social_youtube_channel_email when you need YouTube channel About page from YouTube's public page data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

tag.description: Hashtag without #, letters, digits or _ (2-50 characters)
